power.input_voltage_v.value: 3.3 V single externally supplied rail; no onboard regulator

pcb.layer_count.value: 2 layers, standard 1.6 mm FR-4; exception only if documented RF impedance/matching evidence requires more

pcb.copper_weight.value: ASSUMED 1 oz; confirm selected fabricator stackup before layout release

interface.host_logic_voltage.value: ASSUMED 3.3 V logic only; no level shifting

component.transceiver.value: AT86RF233-ZU only; AT86RF231, AT86RF212, and other families forbidden

firmware.xiao_esp32c6_gpio_wiring.value: Defaults: MOSI GPIO18, MISO GPIO20, SCLK GPIO19, SEL GPIO17, IRQ GPIO2, RESET GPIO1, SLP_TR GPIO0; configurable in ESP-IDF; avoid strapping GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO15
